title: Man with drug-related records arrested with 791 yaba pills
summary: KOTA BARU: A 47-year-old man, with four drug-related records, and found with 791 yaba pills weighing 87.71g, was arrested in a raid at Kampung Pasir Parit, Chetok in Pasir Mas last night.
